response.query: Which formal risk-of-bias tools will we deploy per study design (e.g., RoB 2, ROBINS-I, QUIPS, or an adapted checklist for cross-sectional IoT adoption studies) and what numeric thresholds will affect inclusion or weighting?
response.answer: For randomized trials, use RoB 2; for non-randomized studies, use ROBINS-I; for cross-sectional IoT studies, adapt QUIPS. No specific numeric thresholds for inclusion or weighting are universally applied.
